assessment: Tomcat JVM heap memory exhausted: OutOfMemoryError in Java heap space
recommendedActions: Analyze heap dump file (.hprof) using Eclipse Memory Analyzer (MAT) to identify memory leaks.
Inspect object reference leaks in user HTTP sessions and application in-memory caches.
Increase JVM heap memory allocation (-Xmx and -Xms) in CATALINA_OPTS based on host capacity.
Restart the Tomcat service to release retained heap memory space.

assessment: Tomcat JVM class metadata exhausted: OutOfMemoryError in Metaspace
recommendedActions: Check for potential ClassLoader leaks caused by repeated hot-redeployment without JVM restart.
Review dynamic libraries generating runtime classes (e.g., CGLIB, Javassist, ByteBuddy).
Increase JVM startup parameter -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize in Tomcat configuration.
Perform a full restart of the Tomcat container to reset Metaspace memory allocation.

assessment: Tomcat TLS communication failure: SSL/TLS handshake failed with upstream service
recommendedActions: Check SSL/TLS certificate expiration and certificate chain validity on upstream backend servers.
Ensure issuer CA certificates (including intermediates) are imported into Tomcat truststore (/conf/truststore.p12).
Verify cipher suite and TLS protocol compatibility (TLSv1.2 / TLSv1.3) between client and server.
Test TLS handshake manually using: openssl s_client -connect <host>:<port>.

pattern: Connection is not available, request timed out after
assessment: HikariCP connection pool timeout: Unable to obtain connection within connectionTimeout period
recommendedActions: Enable leakDetectionThreshold parameter in HikariCP configuration to detect unclosed connections.
Review connection pool utilization and increase maximumPoolSize if backend database capacity permits.
Check for slow SQL queries or table locks in the backend PostgreSQL/MySQL database.
Ensure database connections are properly closed within try-with-resources blocks in application code.

assessment: Tomcat web application deployment failure: Context initialization failed during startup
recommendedActions: Check catalina.out logs for root cause exceptions in web.xml or Spring ApplicationContext configurations.
Ensure all dependency libraries (JAR files) in WEB-INF/lib are present and compatible.
Verify file permissions and directory ownership for webapps/ROOT.
Verify integrity of deployed WAR files or application artifacts.

assessment: Tomcat JVM thread deadlock: Multiple threads blocked waiting for synchronized locks
recommendedActions: Capture a complete thread dump snapshot (jstack <pid>) to analyze inter-thread lock cycles.
Identify monitor locks and blocked resources in the affected thread stack traces.
Review lock acquisition ordering across synchronization modules in application code.
Perform a planned restart of the Tomcat container to release locked threads.

assessment: Tomcat upstream network timeout: Read timed out while waiting for external service response
recommendedActions: Check availability, network latency, and CPU load on upstream backend microservices / APIs.
Review connectTimeout and readTimeout parameters in application HTTP clients / RestTemplate / WebClient.
Consider implementing Circuit Breaker patterns and fallback mechanisms to avoid request queue buildup.
Inspect firewall and network security group logs for dropped TCP packets.

assessment: Database query execution timeout: SQL operation exceeded configured timeout threshold
recommendedActions: Analyze slow query logs on the backend database to identify suboptimal queries.
Check database index availability (missing indexes) and execute EXPLAIN ANALYZE on slow queries.
Check for table or row locks holding up database transaction execution.
Adjust queryTimeout parameter on DataSource or optimize application query algorithms.

assessment: Tomcat JVM GC overhead limit exceeded: CPU exhausted by intensive GC thrashing
recommendedActions: Review JVM memory generation ratios (-XX:NewRatio and -XX:SurvivorRatio).
Analyze transient object allocation rate impacting the Young Generation.
Increase total Heap capacity (-Xmx) or migrate to a modern Garbage Collector (G1GC / ZGC).
Profile application object allocations using async-profiler or JProfiler.

assessment: Tomcat JVM off-heap memory exhausted: OutOfMemoryError in Direct byte buffer
recommendedActions: Increase direct buffer memory allocation via JVM option: -XX:MaxDirectMemorySize=<size>.
Check for unclosed response streams or unreleased ByteBuffers in application I/O modules.
Inspect host native container memory utilization via cgroup memory metrics.
Ensure network / HTTP client libraries explicitly release direct buffers.
